admittance.question: What is the variable represented on the x-axis of the chart?
admittance.why_unrecoverable: The x-axis title is the only textual indicator of the variable being plotted horizontally. Without this label, there is no other visual or textual cue to identify the variable, as the numeric values alone do not provide context.
admittance.expected_behavior: Model should admit it cannot determine this information

inductance.question: Which dataset achieves the lowest NPMI score across all weights of negative sampling?
inductance.reasoning_path: The red line consistently has the lowest NPMI scores across all weights of negative sampling. The legend associates the red line with the 'IMDB' label, making it inferable.
inductance.why_inferable: The color of the line and its position relative to other lines provide a deterministic reasoning path to identify the dataset.
inductance.expected_behavior: Model should attempt to infer from visual context
